name: Fire Giant Flameskull

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.details: The flameskull sheds bright light out to 5 squares. It can reduce its brightness to dim light out to 2 squares as a free action.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: The flameskull regains 10 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. Whenever the flameskull takes radiant damage, its regeneration does not function on its next turn.

powers.name: Mage Hand
powers.description: The hand persists until the end of the flameskull’s next turn.

effect.description: Ranged 5; the flameskull conjures a spectral, floating hand in an unoccupied square within range. The hand lasts until the end of the flameskull’s next turn or until it uses this power again. While the hand persists, the flameskull can take the following actions.
nestedAttackDescriptions: The hand picks up or manipulates an object of 20 pounds or less. It can hold one object at a time.
The hand moves up to 5 squares in any direction, carrying the object it holds.
The hand drops the object it is holding.
